# Mr Najib Daulatzai: Colorectal & General Surgeon

> Consultant colorectal and general surgeon in London and Hertfordshire, offering NHS and private surgical care with expertise in robotic (da Vinci), laparoscopic, and endoscopic procedures.

Official website: https://www.ndsurgeon.com

## About

Mr Najib Daulatzai is a consultant colorectal and general surgeon. He holds an NHS consultant post at West Hertfordshire Teaching Hospitals NHS Trust (Watford General Hospital) and sees private patients at Spire Bushey Hospital, HCA The Wellington Hospital (London), and HCA Golders Green Outpatients.

Specialties: colorectal surgery, general surgery, proctology, hernia repair, colonoscopy and endoscopy, minimally invasive surgery, robotic colorectal surgery (Intuitive da Vinci system).

## Procedures offered

Proctology: haemorrhoids (piles), anal fissures, anal fistulas, pilonidal disease, rectal prolapse.

Colorectal: colorectal cancer, inflammatory bowel disease (Crohn's, ulcerative colitis), ileal pouch (J-pouch) surgery, diverticular disease.

Hernia: inguinal, femoral, umbilical, incisional hernias and abdominal wall reconstruction.

Endoscopy: diagnostic colonoscopy, surveillance colonoscopy, therapeutic colonoscopy and polypectomy, flexible sigmoidoscopy.

Additional: stoma formation and reversal, appendicectomy.

All procedure detail pages: https://www.ndsurgeon.com/procedures/[procedure-slug]

## GP and NHS referrals

NHS referrals via e-RS to West Hertfordshire Teaching Hospitals NHS Trust. Private referrals to the practice secretary with a referral letter.
